sents.t: On October 31st, I celebrated my first Halloween.
In the morning, Emma came to the bookstore in a witch costume, with a black hat and a green face!
Mr. Lee wore cat ears.
In the afternoon, I carved my pumpkin with Rosa.
We cut a scary face into it and put a candle inside.
Now it was a jack-o’-lantern.
In the evening, I wore a simple costume.
I was a pirate!
Rosa made a funny costume for Max.
He was a hot dog!
Then the trick-or-treaters came.
Children in costumes walked from house to house and knocked on doors.
There were princesses, superheroes, ghosts, and little monsters.
They said, “Trick or treat!” and we gave them candy.
I gave away three big bags of candy!
At nine o’clock, Carlos and Emma took me to a Halloween party.
Everyone wore costumes.
We ate pumpkin pie and played games.
When I came home, my candy bag was empty, but my heart was full.
Halloween was so much fun!

comp.q: What did Sam and Rosa make?
comp.fa: سام و رزا چه درست کردند؟
